visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair, wearing a navy floral Hawaiian shirt over a white t-shirt with a blue 'DAL' logo, sits in a dark green airplane seat with his arms crossed. He wears green-tinted pixelated sunglasses and leans back against the headrest in a resting posture. The background shows a dimly lit airplane cabin with rows of empty seats receding into the distance. (2) The man suddenly flinches and wakes up, his eyes widening in surprise. He quickly pulls off the pixelated sunglasses with his right hand, revealing a startled facial expression. He looks directly at the camera and then glances to his left and right nervously as if reacting to an external sound. (3) He pulls out a smartphone and stares at the screen with an increasingly worried expression, then looks around the cabin frantically. He reaches down towards his lap, adjusting his waistband or seatbelt area while shifting his torso uncomfortably in the seat. (4) The man places his right hand on his chest and begins to pant heavily, his mouth open and eyes squinting in a display of physical distress or panic. He looks upwards and shifts his body weight repeatedly. (5) The camera executes a rapid zoom-in on a different man's face who appears for a split second, screaming with a wide-open mouth and intense eyes before the frame blurs.

(7) [Subtitle]: 跑道上有許多關稅障礙. (8) [Subtitle]: 會造成降落過程不太平順. (9) [Subtitle]: 請各位豎直您的椅背. (10) [Subtitle]: 勒緊您的褲帶. (11) [Subtitle]: 收起您近期的旅遊或消費計畫. (12) [Subtitle]: 並停止操作電子儀器. (13) [Subtitle]: 一起看窗外天空. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a low-frequency hum characteristic of an airplane cabin. A sharp, digital 'ding-dong' chime sounds clearly, mimicking a passenger announcement trigger. (2) A male voice speaks with a calm, professional tone, slightly filtered to sound like a PA broadcast. The speech is moderately paced with standard enunciation. (3) The speaker's delivery continues, but a second layer of sound emerges: quick, sharp inhalations and fabric rustling sounds from the person on screen. The 'pilot's' voice remains steady while describing an emergency. (4) The vocal density increases as the pilot speaks faster about 'tightening belts.' The foreground character's breathing becomes a series of high-pitched, rhythmic gasps, indicating extreme anxiety and hyperventilation. (5) The announcement ends, and a sudden, unfiltered, high-intensity male scream erupts, peaking in volume and spectral brightness before a quick cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a metaphorical airplane emergency announcement to satirize the volatility or 'crash' of the Taiwan stock market (referred to as the 'Taiwan Stock Flight'). It contrasts the calm, professional tone of a pilot with the increasing panic of a passenger to create humor regarding financial loss.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses cognitive dissonance between the auditory 'pilot' instructions and the visual 'financial panic' context.
